title: Best-Effort Durability (No fsync)
pattern: Writing critical state changes to persistent storage without invoking an explicit file synchronization barrier (`fsync`).
why_bad: Operating systems cache writes in RAM write buffers. If a power outage or system crash occurs before the buffer is flushed to non-volatile storage, the write is lost or partially committed, violating the durability guarantees of the database [39:51].
detection: Writing to a file representing a database commit log, WAL, or persistent index structure without calling `file.sync_all()` or using synchronous I/O options [39:51].
fix: Invoke `sync_all()` on the file handle or open the file with synchronous flags before acknowledging the operation to the caller [39:51].
